answers.core: This is a core part of the way GDScript works so cannot be changed via an add-on, at least not without a lot of extra work.
answers.workaround:
I'm not aware of a complete workaround. Each Enum is unique and would require manual rewriting.

There is a specific solution for Error, but not for other enums. Also the `error_string` function can't type check for `Error` due to the way it is implemented, so any `int` value can be passed to it.

```gdscript
func _ready():
  print(error_string(48)) # printer on fire! the type checker has failed me!
```

There's no builtin solution for  `MIDIMessage` or `MouseButton`, so copy and pasting is the soup of the day.

title: Allow GlobalScope pseudo-enums to act like real enums in GDScript
